title: Arkham CEO on $1 Billion of U.S. Government Bitcoin Moved to “Unknown” Wallet
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Arkham CEO on $1 Billion of U.S. Government Bitcoin Moved to “Unknown” Wallet A US gov wallet moved $1B in BTC.
